text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Choose **Cerebras CS-3** for EXCAVA’s core LLM workloads. It’s the only system that trains and runs giant models like Llama 3.3 70B at full speed without batching—meaning zero latency for real-time tasks. The trade-off is cost: a CS-3 cluster costs millions upfront, but it eliminates the 0.5%+ capability loss from model switching or partial batching that cheaper GPUs force. If budget allows, this is the only move that guarantees a measurable jump in raw power without compromises.

name: Torque
text: Cerebras CS-3 locks EXCAVA into a single vendor’s stack—meaning if Cerebras fails, changes pricing, or drops support, we lose the model *and* the hardware. Mistral’s 8x22B runs on standard GPUs, is portable, and costs a fraction of the CS-3’s upfront burn—so the 0.5% capability gain isn’t worth the vendor death grip. Run a head-to-head benchmark: if Mistral’s 8x22B loses by <0.5% on our core tasks, we drop Cerebras.
